next_exact_action: Evaluate the lattice sums with `r` as an interval over the band. That yields G12-band enclosures, hence `Î(r)/r³ ≤ F(G12-band)` for the whole band — a finite computation per band, never a fitted exponent.

not_a_substitute.quote: RUNG2 (`r = 0.025`) and RUNG3 (`r = 0.035355`) certify those rungs only.

RUNG2/RUNG3 certify those rungs only. They do **not** discharge `OBL-D1-PROMOTE`, `OBL-H5-JETMOD`, ZBAND-hi or REMOTE-THRESHOLD. The displayed modulus is dense certified sampling plus an explicit fit.

repo_state_note: `research/interval/` supplies certified interval arithmetic over exact rationals and names this lane as a consumer; the interval-`r` lattice-sum evaluator for the 24-jet set, and any per-band enclosure certificate, do not exist in this repository. `repo_state` describes only what code exists in this repository. It is not a mathematical status and no verdict, promotion or discharge may be read from it.
does_not_establish: This lane file establishes nothing mathematical. It does not certify any band enclosure, does not discharge `OBL-H5-JETMOD` or `OBL-D1-PROMOTE`, and does not make the displayed modulus into a certified enclosure.
obligation: Certified interval bounds for the full 24-jet set — not just the displayed `c₂` — over the r-bands `[r_{k+1}, r_k]`, with lattice-tail constants re-certified **uniformly in the band** (the current LAT tail bound certifies at point separations only). Content: for each jet `J` and band `B`, `J(B)/r^{p_J} ∈` a certified interval.
